_comment: Migration target allowlist. Fingerprints only — no hosts, no URLs, no credentials.
A fingerprint is sha256(normalized_host + "|" + database_name) of the parsed
DATABASE_URL. It is one-way: this file cannot be reversed into a connection
string. It also does NOT prove ownership of the database, nor that the URL is
the one the Production runtime actually uses. Enrolment is a reviewed identity
ENROLLED 2026-10-18 with exactly one Production fingerprint: the Neon Production
database `neondb` on the `production` branch of project damp-forest-92941163.
The matching Preview endpoint (jata_preview) and the CI disposable database are
mode and fingerprints must agree: 'unenrolled' requires an empty list; 'enrolled'
requires at least one fingerprint and a non-empty enrollmentEvidence string.
The rule "a non-production environment may never migrate an enrolled Production
target" only has effect while this list is non-empty. Emptying it silently
re-opens the cross-environment gap that rule exists to close.
Enrolling a value while Production builds are still expected to succeed means
the first Production build after merge will run prisma migrate deploy. Enrol and
enable in the same reviewed change, or accept that Production builds are refused
